strings.Настройки, тема и громкость хранятся тол: Settings, theme and volume are stored only on this computer and are never sent anywhere.
strings.Вернуть тему, шрифт, уведомления и остал: Return the theme, font, notifications and all other options to their defaults.
strings.Показывать системное уведомление с назва: Show a system notification with the title and artist when a new track starts.
strings.Только в свёрнутом окне: Only when the window is in the background
strings.Не показывать уведомления, пока окно при: Do not show notifications while the app window is active.
strings.Отключить системный звук при показе увед: Turn off the system sound when a notification appears.
strings.Показать тестовое уведомление с текущими: Show a test notification with the current settings.
strings.Сразу включать следующий трек, когда тек: Start the next track as soon as the current one ends. When off, playback stops.
strings.Сохранять положение ползунка громкости м: Keep the volume slider position between launches.
strings.От светлой до тёмной: потяните ползунок: From light to dark: drag the slider or click a name.
strings.Подкрашивает фон и акценты. Без цвета ин: Tints the background and accents. With no color the interface stays neutral and the accent comes from the platform.
strings.Цвет самого фона: он виден за обоями и п: The color of the background itself: it shows behind the wallpaper and under transparent panels, and does not recolor the panels. It has its own saturation, brightness depends on the theme.
strings.Основной цвет текста и значков. «Авто» п: The main color of text and icons. "Auto" follows the theme.
strings.Список берётся из папки fonts в папке пр: The list comes from the fonts folder in the project folder: put a font file or folder there and it will appear here.
strings.Базовый размер текста интерфейса, осталь: The base text size of the interface; other sizes scale proportionally.
strings.Свой файл картинки для фона приложения (: Your own image file for the app background (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP, AVIF). The file is copied to the app data folder, so the original can be deleted.
strings.Растянуть на весь размер, вписать без де: Stretch to fill, fit without distortion, fill the window with cropping, original size or tiled. Below is the position: corners, edges and center.
strings.Размывает картинку, чтобы текст на ней ч: Blurs the picture so the text on top is easier to read.
strings.Панели слегка размывают и искажают обои: Panels slightly blur and distort the wallpaper under them. Visible when panels are semi-transparent. 0 turns the effect off.
strings.Тонкая обводка, чтобы текст и значки не: A thin outline so text and icons do not get lost on busy wallpapers: strength, color and whether it applies to icons. 0 turns the outline off.
strings.Отдельный ползунок для каждого элемента:: A separate slider for every element: title bar, side panel, window background (the top bar shares it), main canvas, cards and rows, buttons, fields and headings, player, settings window and lines. Elements are independent: a card can be transparent even if the canvas is not. 100% is opaque (the default), 0% is fully transparent.
strings.Фоновый узор на боковой панели, верхнем: A background pattern on the side panel, title bar and player: dots, grid, crosses or none. The slider sets how visible it is.
strings.Как отмечать платформу у треков в списке: How to mark the platform on tracks in "All tracks" and in the player at the bottom.
strings.Увеличивает или уменьшает весь интерфейс: Enlarges or shrinks the whole interface: text, icons and spacing. Applied when you release the slider. The font size above changes only the text.
strings.Русский встроен. Остальные языки берутся: Russian is built in. Other languages come from .json files in the locales folder: put a file there, click "Refresh list" and the language will appear in the list.
strings.Скопируйте en.json, переведите значения: Copy en.json, translate the values to the right of the colon (do not change the Russian keys on the left), change name and code, and save the file in the same folder. Phrases without a translation stay in Russian.
strings.Показывать в профиле Discord, какой трек: Show the track that is playing in your Discord profile.
strings.Управлять воспроизведением клавишами кла: Control playback with keyboard keys and from the Windows panel.
strings.Пробел: пауза и воспроизведение. Alt+← и: Space: pause and play. Alt+← and Alt+→: back and forward through sections. Esc: close settings.
